changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.15
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_reconcile_commit(p_owner text, p_run_id text) RETURNS jsonb (RDR-229 P2.10, nexus-p2m1x.15): CREATE OR REPLACE of the catalog-048-2 function so that its three note-URI rewrites follow NoteUri.moveTo: only an nx-note:// URI whose old collection carries no rdr__, docs__ or code__ prefix is rewritten, and the chroma:// arm is gone. The signature, owner, security posture and grant are unchanged. A function definition; no data effect at migration time. The rollback restores the catalog-048-2 body.

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.15
changeSet.comment: Register the data move rdr229-residue-catalog-documents over nexus.catalog_documents (RDR-229 P2.10, nexus-p2m1x.15): one INSERT into nexus.data_moves, and nothing else. Its on_complete registers the two satellite moves rdr229-residue-document-aspects and rdr229-residue-document-highlights with changeset_id catalog-049-2, the changeset whose text holds their INSERT. Sizing was measured on a production PITR fork 2026-11-20 (T2 nexus/engine-cut-0.1.200; the fork carried 0 chroma:// URIs, so the timing is the walk alone): see the file header.
